components: An alternating reciprocal shuttle uses four addressable cells, a shared role bit, and full-configuration equality. With separated fixed binary encoding and no extra persistent state, affine and one-AND circuits admit only the scoped short cycles; a two-Toffoli ternary factor supplies the longer examples.

A six-symbol relay supplies a diagonal identification and a relative two-cell incidence analyzer. Full-state triple reversal makes the even words commute; a coordinate echo alone does not enforce this on a carried bit.

The four-symbol relay, reciprocal link-bit lifts and independently supplied orthogonal rotations are controls. The finite quotient fits two solo rows without fixing mixed-word returns across these families.
candidates.declared_status: Finite reversible constructions and conditional resource arguments. Full-orbit period is not a six-valued local reading, and the coordinate echo does not select the full dynamics.
missing_bridges: Derive the physical cells, compatible state encoding and addressable reciprocal actuation rather than supplying them as circuitry or endpoint equivalence.
Specify how a local preparation and analyzer access the required relative symbol or carried bit, and justify which echo laws apply to complete physical states.

sources.text:
Premises: four independently addressable cells, one shared role bit h, identical
reciprocal updates, and exact equality of the FULL configuration as the mark.
The all-configuration rigidity argument in probe_shuttle_local_reunions reduces
the noncommuting triple-reversal case to G(h,x)=(1-h,f^(+/-1)(x)). Here we
ask what encodes that branch with separated wires (h,e(x)), a fixed injective
cell encoding, and no extra persistent state. X/CNOT and arbitrary affine
wiring are free in the nonlinear count. A scalar AND costs one; Toffoli costs
one such AND. These are circuit resources, not physically measured primitives.

Lower bound independent of cell encoding: on a cycle e_0,...,e_(n-1) of f,
flipping h changes the cell output by D_i=e_(i-1) XOR e_(i+1). For an affine
map this difference is constant, so e_(i+4)=e_i. With at most one scalar AND
the whole output is Bz+c+v*L1(z)*L2(z) for affine forms L1,L2; its h-difference
therefore has at most two values a,b. Successive vertices of a step-by-two
orbit are separated by a or b. Each such orbit has length n/gcd(n,2), lives
in a coset of span(a,b), and has at most four vertices. It cannot be a
triangle: three distinct vertices have three distinct nonzero edge XORs.
Thus n/gcd(n,2) is 1,2 or 4, and n is 1,2,4 or 8. C4 and C8 below attain
the zero- and one-AND bounds. In particular one AND cannot give a factor
three, even on an admitted subset. No enumeration of all circuits is needed.
Role-dependent encodings, nonlinear decoders, uncounted memory or selecting
outputs would change this contract; a clean constant work wire would not.

To construct the ternary factor, A(u,v)=(u XOR v,u) cycles the three nonzero
binary pairs. Apply A unconditionally, then apply A when h=1: A^2=A^-1.
The second A costs two Toffolis. Combine with a toggled bit for a valid C6
on six of eight symbols, or with affine C4 for C4+C12 on ALL sixteen.
When all cell patterns must pass the short spatial echo test, every f-cycle
must have length >=4. For at most eight binary symbols the only nonempty
cycle partitions satisfying that bound at power-of-two size are (4), (8),
and (4,4); none has order divisible by 3. Four binary cell bits are minimal
under both requirements. Every even port word acts by signed powers of f on
individual cells; every odd word squares to identity. Supplying four ports,
their actuation, the vector wires and a program is not deriving those items.
No permutation on a full 2^N-state register has period six at every root:
six would divide the number of states. The four-step program below has order
six on the full space, but an orbit has period six iff at least one of its
two addressed cells belongs to C12. That is full-configuration period, not
necessarily a six-valued reading of the first cell. Counts of Toffolis refer
to one address operation, not an entire program. No fringe, physical detector,
derivation of dimension, or Lean theorem is established.

def controlled_triangle(u: int, v: int) -> Circuit:
    # Two CNOTs implement A; controlling each by the OLD bit 0 implements c-A.
    return ((v, u), (u, v), (0, v, u), (0, u, v))


# Wire 0 is h; packed cell bits begin at wire 1. Changes to h are always last.
C4: Circuit = ((1, 2), (0, 2), (1,), (0,))
C8: Circuit = ((0, 1), (0, 2), (1, 2, 3), (0, 2), (0, 1)) + C4
TRIANGLE_BIT: Circuit = controlled_triangle(2, 3) + ((1,), (0,))
TRIANGLE_C4: Circuit = controlled_triangle(3, 4) + C4

Assumptions: four labeled reciprocal ports; abc=cba everywhere on COMPLETE
states. Put r_i=T_i T_0. Then r_i r_j=r_j r_i, and T_0 r_i T_0=r_i^-1.
Even words are commuting translations; odd words are involutions. In
particular two native words of order six MUST commute. Agreement merely
on positions is weaker, as demonstrated by the link-bit lift below.

Conditional size bound: on a finite A3/L endpoint quotient with four
globally permutable ports and two distinct roles, let m be the common
order of e_i-e_j. They generate A3/L, hence its exponent is exactly m.
Actual order six needs 6|m (fitting six observations does not). For v in L,
v-(ij)v=(v_i-v_j)(e_i-e_j) is in L, so v_i=v_j modulo m. Thus L/mA3
lies in the diagonal, of size gcd(4,m), inside the m^3-element A3/mA3.
At m=6 the bound is 108 per role; m>=12 already gives >=12^3/4.
The two-element diagonal at six attains the bound. This quotient is a
specified identification, NOT a new local interaction selected by IDT.

On the old four-cycle shuttle, every native permutation has order dividing
four. A time-homogeneous stochastic mixture of those permutation matrices
cannot have a primitive sixth-root peripheral eigenvalue: if Kv=zv, |z|=1,
the average of equal-norm P_g v has that same norm, hence every positively
weighted P_g v=zv. None admits z. Thus no exact, indefinitely persistent
sixth harmonic of a fixed linear readout, not a bound from six samples,
nor a ban on time-dependent control, extra memory or a different machine.

One mixed-pulse test separates machines matching BOTH single-axis rows:
the plain relay returns probability 1, an explicit reciprocal link-bit
lift 3/4, and separately supplied orthogonal 60-degree rotations 29/32.
The lift detects phase plus a carried polarity; its mark pattern, preferred
ports and analyzer are additional structure. With four equiprobable histories
and a deterministic readout, every probability is a multiple of 1/4 anyway.
The reference response cannot exclude other source or detection mechanisms.

The six-cycle actuator, specific words, fair preparation choices and
two-cell relative-symbol analyzer are inputs; no native local comparator,
spatial axes, Hilbert amplitudes, Born law, or experimental result follows.
All counts below are finite computations. The general arguments are not
machine-checked theorems.

def link_lift(m: Model, two_axes: bool) -> Ports:
    # No schedule or global path label: a bit changes only on a marked
    # undirected port-2 link, using its unique role-0 endpoint to set the mark.
    def step(p: int, full: int) -> int:
        s, bit = divmod(full, 2)
        t = m.ports[p][s]
        base = s if m.role(s) == 0 else t
        phi = m.phase(base)
        eta = (m.symbol(base, 0) - m.symbol(base, 3)) % 6
        zeta = (eta + phi) % 6
        # The one-axis decoy marks two phase levels. The two-axis control
        # marks a rectangle in two relative-symbol readings. It deliberately
        # breaks compass symmetry on the fiber, not on the projected relay.
        mark = (eta in (2, 3) and zeta in (3, 4)) if two_axes else phi in (0, 1)
        return 2 * t + (bit ^ int(p == 2 and mark))

    return tuple(tuple(step(p, s) for s in range(2 * len(m.reps))) for p in PORTS)
